verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Manufact exposing hosted servers and its own platform as MCP endpoints, with one-click or copy-paste setup for editors and chat clients such as Cursor, VS Code and Claude. Nothing in the pack documents adapters or integration guides for the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. Generic MCP compatibility is not evidence of documented framework adapters.
